newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut up in flat Lebanon market.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut up in flat Lebanon market.

text.p: Bank of Beirut hit a record high but most shares were flat on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.62 percent to 192.97. The BLOM general index fell 0.03 percent to 1114.41 and the LISPI climbed 0.17 percent to 96.50.
Solidere A and B held steady at $13.00 and $13.1250 respectively.
Bank of Beirut climbed to a high of $5.25 from $5.0625.
"Most brokers expect that Bank of Beirut will reach $6 next week," said one broker who asked not to be named.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was flat at $22.25. Banque Audi fell to $27.8750 from $28.3750
BSE turnover climbed to 233,746 from 170,196 for a value of $2,630,369 against $1,999,239.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Uniceramic, Ciments Blanc and Eternit.
